never_assumes_8h: the cashflow iterates actual certified rows; the interval histogram shows the provider's own cadence is read per row
role: CASHFLOW LEG ONLY - funding is never an ARC-03 signal input

settlement_count_never_hardcoded.arc01_defect_avoided: ARC-01's '9 settlements' prose imprecision is not repeated: ARC-03 has no settlement-count constant anywhere
settlement_count_never_hardcoded.spec_statement: the accounting iterates the ACTUAL certified settlements in the window and never assumes a fixed count such as 9 (an ARC-01 documentation defect this prereg deliberately avoids)

sign_proof.verified_in: verifier_independent_pit.py battery (4 sign tests) and the builder's prereg unit tests

signal_input_check.grep_signal_path_for_funding: the signal path is src/trading_bot/research/arc03/arc03_authority.py; funding lives in arc03_funding.py and is imported by nothing in the signal path
signal_input_check.spec_signal_use: NONE - funding is not a signal input for ARC-03

zero_settlement_is_valid_zero: a 60-minute hold frequently contains no settlement; the accounting returns 0.0 and 0 settlements, not an error
